newsitem.title: USA: Central Co-op settles suit with Genesis.
newsitem.headline: Central Co-op settles suit with Genesis.

text.p: Central Co-operative Bank said Tuesday a litigation settlement with Genesis Financial Partners LP requires Genesis to cut its holdings to below five percent ownership within the year and prohibits Genesis from soliciting proxies on any other issues so long as it owns Central Co-op stock.
Central's Senior Vice President William Morrissey said Genesis presently has 6.4 percent ownership in the bank.
The settlement ends a counter-suit Central Co-op launched after Genesis sued to inspect Central's shareholder lists.
The Massachusettes Co-operative bank, which operates eight full service offices in Boston, said the settlement forces Genesis to be a purely passive investor in Central Co-op.
